intent.raw: Define and design the missing working ontology prototype and show its architecture and example.
intent.objective: Author a governed Define and Design package for the smallest private ontology-oriented candidate-graph validation and inspection prototype without implementing it or inflating its authority.

technique_overlays.trigger: The prototype evaluates ontology-oriented candidates near private authority sources.
technique_overlays.validation_expectation: The authored contracts separate policy disposition, candidate projection, run evidence, semantic admission, and promotion authority.

subagent_strategy.trigger: The research fan-out is already closed and the user selected one bounded Define and Design synthesis.
subagent_strategy.explanation: This route needs one coherent owner synthesis over accepted evidence; no independent execution lane or delegated mutation is required.
context: The prior governed research selected the finite five-node witness.
The route authors documents and deterministic Design receipts only.
No implementation, product repair, or authority mutation is in scope.

steps.name: Bind research, Inventory, ontology, edge-law, and authority evidence
stop_conditions: Stop if the accepted research does not support a finite build-from-owned target.
Stop if a source digest cannot be pinned.
Stop before treating Inventory as ontology or promotion authority.

steps.name: Author Define and exact six-view Design with a worked example
stop_conditions: Stop if any Design selector is missing, stale, self-issued, or unbound.
Stop if policy disposition becomes semantic admission.
Stop if the candidate projection is described as canonical ontology.
Stop before Plan, work-pack creation, implementation, IOLM repair, or authority mutation.

steps.name: Reduce and recompose the smallest coherent design unit
stop_conditions: Stop if reduction removes graph, policy, projection, evidence, or authority separation.
Stop if recomposition requires IOLM, Ponder, hierarchy, or promotion in the first unit.
Do not claim runtime evidence from the Design result.

gates.condition: Every load-bearing obligation maps to a concrete current source at its declared authority.
The package remains candidate-only, read-only toward governed inputs, and has no semantic-admission or promotion effect.
The denominator resolves, every signal is bound, two passes reach a fixed point, and all selected outputs are authored.
The owner accepts this candidate Design before Invoke Plan begins.

boundaries.contract: Research selects a candidate target and evidence ceiling; Define owns the specification without upgrading the research verdict.
A finite policy disposition and receipt never admit meaning or mutate promotion state.
Design-validator-pass allows owner review of a Plan route; it does not authorize Plan, Task Session, or implementation by itself.

authority.lifecycle: Invoke owns only this candidate Define and Design lifecycle.
authority.execution: No prototype runtime execution or implementation is authorized.
authority.validation: Context Builder, Dispatch Spec, Invoke Design selection, and Distill.
authority.evidence: Pinned repository sources plus generated Design receipts.
authority.memory: Inventory is read-only discovery evidence and is not changed by this route.
authority.promotion: Ontology, definitions, authority, release, and human owners remain independent.

state_namespaces.write_policy: Candidate lifecycle artifacts and generated Design receipts only.
Read-only source contracts in this dispatch.

state_namespaces.owner: Poker Team feature and repository owners
state_namespaces.write_policy: Read-only source and adjacent runtime evidence for the worked example.
Read-only capability and validator source; no private content transport.

promotion_splits.rule: Design selection proves authored coverage only; runtime remains unwitnessed.
A finite candidate policy has authority_effect none.

promotion_splits.source: future candidate projection or static report
promotion_splits.rule: All views remain read models bound to one run.

promotion_guardrails: This package is private and candidate; nothing is transported into public Arcanum.
Design-validator-pass is not Plan evidence, implementation evidence, promotion, or publication.
No ontology, authority, definitions, IOLM, Inventory, Craft, or implementation source is mutated.
No work pack, task, SWU, or execution wave is selected.
The stronger bounded ontology prototype label remains unavailable until the complete runtime and human witness exists.
